system_prompt: You are an expert DevOps engineer. Generate production-quality Infrastructure as Code (IaC) in response to the user's natural-language request. Output ONLY the IaC code (no explanation, no markdown fences) in the language explicitly specified by the user. Apply best practices appropriate to a real production deployment, including security defaults.
original_prompt: Generate a CloudFormation template defining an IAM role with a policy that allows EC2 instances to write logs to CloudWatch and read configuration from Parameter Store.
user_message_sent:
Target IaC language: AWS CloudFormation (YAML)

Task: Generate a CloudFormation template defining an IAM role with a policy that allows EC2 instances to write logs to CloudWatch and read configuration from Parameter Store.

Output only the AWS CloudFormation (YAML) code, no commentary or markdown fences.
raw_response:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: IAM role and instance profile for EC2 to write CloudWatch Logs and read from SSM Parameter Store with least-privilege defaults.
Parameters:
  ParameterPathPrefix:
    Type: String
    Default: /app/
    Description: SSM Parameter Store path prefix to allow reading (must start with /). Example /app/
    AllowedPattern: ^/.*$
  LogGroupNamePrefix:
    Type: String
    Default: /ec2/
    Description: CloudWatch Logs log group name prefix allowed for log stream creation and event writes. Example /ec2/
    AllowedPattern: ^[^:*]+$
  PermissionsBoundaryArn:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: Optional IAM permissions boundary ARN to attach to the role. Leave empty to disable.
    AllowedPattern: (^$)|(^arn:.*:iam::[0-9]{12}:policy/.+$)
Conditions:
  UsePermissionsBoundary: !Not [!Equals [!Ref PermissionsBoundaryArn, ""]]
Resources:
  CloudWatchAndSSMReadPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      Path: /
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: CloudWatchLogsCreateAndDescribe
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - logs:CreateLogGroup
              - logs:DescribeLogGroups
              - logs:DescribeLogStreams
            Resource: "*"
          - Sid: CloudWatchLogsStreamAndPut
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - logs:CreateLogStream
              - logs:PutLogEvents
            Resource:
              - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:${LogGroupNamePrefix}*:log-stream:*
          - Sid: SSMParameterReadAccess
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - ssm:GetParameter
              - ssm:GetParameters
              - ssm:GetParametersByPath
            Resource:
              - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:parameter${ParameterPathPrefix}*
          - Sid: SSMDescribeParameters
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - ssm:DescribeParameters
            Resource: "*"
          - Sid: KMSSecureStringDecrypt
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - kms:Decrypt
            Resource: "*"
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                kms:ViaService: !Sub ssm.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com
                kms:CallerAccount: !Sub ${AWS::AccountId}
  Ec2AppRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Path: /
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Ref CloudWatchAndSSMReadPolicy
      PermissionsBoundary: !If [UsePermissionsBoundary, !Ref PermissionsBoundaryArn, !Ref "AWS::NoValue"]
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-ec2-app-role
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation
  Ec2AppInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      Path: /
      Roles:
        - !Ref Ec2AppRole
Outputs:
  RoleArn:
    Value: !GetAtt Ec2AppRole.Arn
    Description: ARN of the IAM role for EC2 instances.
  InstanceProfileArn:
    Value: !GetAtt Ec2AppInstanceProfile.Arn
    Description: ARN of the IAM instance profile to attach to EC2 instances.
  ManagedPolicyArn:
    Value: !Ref CloudWatchAndSSMReadPolicy
    Description: ARN of the managed policy granting CloudWatch Logs write and SSM Parameter Store read access.
